title: Shaligram Arcade
description: Flagship commercial complex on Ambli road with premium retail frontage and Grade-A offices.

specifications.structuralSystem: Heavy-duty commercial RCC column-beam and shear wall core structure engineered for wide column spans (8.4m x 8.4m grid) allowing column-free internal partitioning, with IS 1893 seismic compliance.
unitMix: Ground & First Floor High-Street Retail Showrooms (850 – 3,500 sq.ft.)
vastuHighlights: Grand North and East facing main corporate reception entrances welcoming wealth flow
Executive director cabins situated in South-West sector for authoritative decision-making
Finance and accounts zones placed in North sector (Kuber sthana) for financial abundance
Conference & ideation rooms in North-West (Vayu) quadrant for dynamic brainstorming
amenitiesList: Double-glazed structural unitized glass facade with Low-E thermal coating
Central VRV/VRF air-conditioning provision with energy-recovery ventilation
100% DG backup for essential services, elevators, and common area lighting
Automated multi-level stack/puzzle basement parking systems

floorPlans.title: Ground Level High-Street Retail Master Plan
floorPlans.description: Double-height retail showrooms with wide 15-to-25 ft glass display frontages, uninterrupted pedestrian promenade, separate goods loading dock, and seamless customer drop-off porch.

floorPlans.title: Typical Corporate Office Floor Plan
floorPlans.description: Column-free flexible office modules with 3.6-metre floor-to-floor height, central service core with AHU rooms, electrical/server risers, executive restrooms, and dual fire-escape stairwells.

floorPlans.title: Corporate Executive Suite Plan
floorPlans.description: Bespoke corporate layout featuring private director cabin with panoramic glass corner, 8-seater discussion room, open workstations bay, pantry, and private executive restroom.

floorPlans.title: Subterranean Parking & Logistics Master Plan
floorPlans.description: Wide radius access ramps, automated boom barrier RFID access, fire suppression sprinkler grid, DG room, STP plant, and underground water reservoir.
